verdict.rationale: Notte docs explicitly describe deploying scripts as scheduled, serverless API endpoints that can be 'invoked and scheduled anywhere' (notte-docs-2), plus persistent sessions/cookies (notte-docs-5) and CDP/session infrastructure that support unattended runs. However there's no dedicated 'automation/scheduling dashboard' walkthrough, no independent evidence of long-running background automations succeeding, and one community report of a real-world extraction task failing outright (notte-comm-1). Missing for 10: first-party docs/UI screenshots detailing a scheduler/trigger system, and independent verification that scheduled automations run reliably unattended.
